notes.title: Asura Patch 29045 - French Language in Beta
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/1309fd1f76aefb02c10991f11ab9efe98a02980e.jpg[/img]

Hi Everyone!

We are back with a new patch, and this time we have tried to clean up a lot of fixes in the UI. If we had made an accurate patch log for them then it would have been a disaster. As a result, if you would be interested, please have a look at the concise patch log that we have prepared for you!

[h1]Patch Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue wherein after opening the inventory, shop, etc. the UI wouldn't close when using a controller.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein opening the inventory and pressing the close button would freeze Asura.
[*]Polished UI and font in all languages.
[*]Added new language - French ( Currently in BETA)
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Trigger buttons or R2/L2 wouldn't working on Linux platforms.
[/list]

[h1]Asura French version is now in BETA![/h1]
It would be wonderful if our French players would play the game in the recent addition of French Localization and help us point out any discrepancies. You may opt for the French Beta by following the below instructions:
[olist]
[*]In your Steam library, right click on Asura and click on "Properties"
[*]Click on the BETA tab
[*]Enter the password: asurafrenchtest
[*]Change the drop down to "veng_french-French Public Beta"[/olist]

The French Localization would not have been possible with out the support and contribution of our players namely Liberodark and Philippe Reybaud (pendragon64) and many others. Thank you very much! :)

As always thank you all for playing the game and if there are any issues or bugs you would like to report, please get in touch with us via the below channels

Discord: https://discord.gg/ogreheadstudio
Twitter: https://twitter.com/asurathegame
Email: support@ogrehead.com

Thank you!

Hello Everybody,

We apologise for the delay in this week's patch.  We have now updated the Public test version with the latest fixes.

Our plan was to move the earlier Public test version to the main branch but there has yet again been some changes and fixes which we would like to check thoroughly before pushing it to the main branch.

1.) In your Steam library, right click on Asura and click on "Properties"

[*]Fixed an issue wherein Asura would pass through the walls in Vengeance Mode. 
[*]Removed the number from icon of those consumable items which do not stack.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein the game on rare occasions would not load the subsequent level.

[*]Fixed an issue wherein Asura on rare occasions hover above the ground after walking through an elevated path.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein the controller joystick would not work in Score Screen.[/list]

Thank you for playing Asura and for the support!

Hi,

We are aware that the Vengeance Mode at the moment is a bit too easy for most of you. To fix it, we have made tons of balance changes and fixed issues for the last couple of days. We don't want to make the recent changes live prematurely; hence, we have updated the game in the beta branch known as [b]Vengeance Public test V.28947[/b].

[h1]Patch Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue wherein learning more than 10 passive skills in Vengeance Mode would cause errors in the game.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Range weapon in Vengeance Mode would transfer to Campaign.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Feats in score screen would be in ratios.
[*]Health is now Capped at 45.
[*]Gold is now capped at 1000.
[*]Increased the cost of weapons n the Arsenal of the Vengeance Mode.
[*]Increased the cost of upgrades in the Arsenal of the Vengeance Mode.
[*]Enemy Health and Damage will scale in Vengeance Mode much more efficiently until late game.
[*]Weapons can now burn along with armours.
[/list]

Fixed other minor issues and glitches in the game.

If you would like to opt for it, please follow the below instructions:

1.) In your Steam library, right click on Asura and click on "Properties"
2.) Click on the BETA tab
3.) Enter the password: [b]asurapublictest[/b]
4.) Change the drop down to [b]"Asura Public Beta"[/b]

The above build is scheduled to be live on 7th October. Until then, feel free to share your feedback and suggestions regarding the new balance of the Vengeance mode.

notes.title: Introducing Teleportation And Salvaging Items in Asura!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/09d5ef4975cf6b2fd3283720cde5ebbdc2829d40.png[/img]

Hi,

Asura Patch Update 27907 is now LIVE!

[h1]Tez-Yatra:[/h1]
We have implemented the much-requested Teleportation feature and are calling it Tez-Yatra which means Fast Travel.

Asura can place the Teleporter anywhere in the fortress by pressing the F button ( re-bindable). Once the teleporter has been set, Asura can instantly teleport back to it by pressing the same button. Teleporter can't be set if when fighting enemies. If the teleporter has been placed in an undesired position, it can be destroyed by just pressing and holding down the Teleporter button. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/92151284cfeaca617831a2b23bfd999d50a26079.jpg[/img]

The teleporter can be of great help reducing the backtracking drastically. However, you will need to place them strategically to make the most of it.

[H1]Salvage Items[/h1]
Another new feature is the Salvaging of items. In the latest update, Asura can salvage items for 1 Sona. Any and all item can be salvaged included quiver, meat, weapons, armors, etc. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/c1c023d5594e5b447ed3f7224e305bffe39000bb.jpg[/img]

We added this feature because many times, tons of loot would get left behind for eg. quivers would be a complete waste if you are equipped with a magic weapon. Now at least you can Salvage and earn some extra Sona! :)

We have also fixed some issues with UI and font.

[u]Please note that the controls would have been automatically set to default after this update. Apologies for the inconvenience.[/u]

We hope that you enjoy the latest update and would love to hear your thoughts and suggestions on the same. You can share it via the comments or get in touch with us on our discord: https://discord.gg/2FQ9g2

Thank you for playing Asura!

notes.title: Asura Patch: 27897 | Champion Spawn Re-designed & Other Fixes!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/0c58d45ad541d7b9ef958a71373fe55533d2829b.png[/img]

Hello,

Since our last update, the two of us at Ogre Head has been working on a new spawn system for the Champion units in Asura. You all shared the feedback mentioning that you were finding it difficult to unlock the champions. This is admittedly our fault in the design because we left it entirely under the shroud of randomness. As a result, some players may never face certain Champion units due to unfavourable RNG. 

[u]Without spoiling much, we will try to explain how the new spawn system works. [/u]

We have divided the Champions and distributed them among the three difficulty modes. Champions will unlock as you beat the game in various difficulties. Once unlocked, the units are added to a list of champions. Until you have defeated a particular Champ, they will not randomize. 

The above method makes it certain that you get the opportunity to face all the Champions in the game, unlocking them in the Aukaad as you defeat them.

If you have already beat some Champions, the above system will reset it and will make sure that you get to beat every Champion in the game. However, your Aukaad will remain the same.

Along with the above design changes, we have made some additional fixes. Check out the patch log below to learn more about it.

[H1]Patch Log:[/H1]
[LIST]
[*]Fixed an issue where in the Gold chest would respawn after saving & loading.
[*]Fixed an issue with some Mini-map icons after saving & loading.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein stun particle effect would appear on dead enemies.
[*]Fixed a problem with resurrection mechanic. If you entered an unexplored enemy room after resurrecting by dying in a Boss or Champion room, the enemy rooms would be empty.
[/LIST]

We hope the new Champion system fixes the issues that the old one had. Do let us know your feedback & Suggestions. You can either share your thoughts below or get in touch with us at our discord: 

Thank you for playing Asura and for the amazing support!

Hi,

[h1]Patch Log:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Varjuna ( Daeva Archer Boss) would get stuck when in combat.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Sloth Achievement would be attainable after save and exit. It was an exploit. 
[*]Fixed an issue wherein the 'NO' button for New Game Warning Tab wouldn't work. 
[*]Fixed an issue which would occur when boss death and a spell would activate at the same time.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Balvaan (Hammer weapon) wouldn't play the SFX when it would slam the ground.
[*]Increased the speed of Ghor Parikrama ( Death from above) Shastra sequence.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Monkey would even evade while stunned.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein the fireballs of Anathema Shastra would act like act like a boomerang weapon.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Matka and Jaddi Butti could be used for an indefinite amount of times. 
[*]Fixed an issue with Leaderboard.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein saving and loading the game would not display the item drops in Mini-map.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Totems shot by fireballs would be visible even after destroying the Totems.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Guardian room icon would overlap with another icon in Mini-map
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Asura footsteps could be heard when using a Magic weapon.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein Yartigaa & Vamii ( Vanara Boss) marker would sink partially in the ground.
[*]Fixed an issue with Lohaar exit button when using a controller.
[*]Fixed an issue wherein the Hit Particle in Totem would appear outside the mesh.
[*]Fixed error/typo in the loading screen.[/list]

Apart from these new fixes, if you recollect, we had a Beta running for about a week which had many other improvements, fixes, as well as the Keyboard only controls. We have moved all those changes to the current version.

[h1]Here is the patch log of the beta:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where in Hahthira Vayraath (Elephant Beamer) wouldn't die when using Vyakujit Kavach (Blast Shield).
[*]Optimized the game and decreased it's RAM usage. We are hopeful that players with low RAM should also be able to play Asura optimally. However, we recommend that you have at least 2 GB of [*]Free Memory available while playing Asura.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Varjun would get stuck when Asura would cast a spell on him.
[*]Fixed an issue where the invisible wall would generate in levels.
[*]Tons of UI fixes and polish.
[*]Fixed an issue where in spells like Swastya Hathoda would not work as intended if the targeted enemy would die before it hit them.
[*]Added back button for Lohaar (Black Smith) and Dukaan (Shop) when using Control Scheme C.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Footsteps wouldn't sound as intended when sprinting or moving at high speed.
[*]Changed the name of the various traps in the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Melee weapon abilities would work with a ranged weapon.
[*]Fixed an issue where in pots or breakables would provide experience orbs after reaching Maximum Level.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Camera would lose focus from Asura resulting in a black screen.
[*]You can now roll and destroy destructible. Yes, we too are big fans of DARK SOULS! :)[/list]

As always, we look forward to your experience playing Asura with the latest update. Please do share your feedback & suggestions via our email: support(at)ogrehead(dot)com or join our discord: https://discord.gg/7ZRQhrZ

Thank you!

[list][*]Fixed an issue where in Spearman units would get stuck near the wall in their run animation

[h1]Regarding the WASD Controls[/h1]

The WASD controls is intended to be played with Keyboard and Mouse where in you use keyboard to move and mouse to attack. This scheme does not allow you to play the game only with keyboard.

We are working on a Keyboard only control scheme and will be updating it very soon.

[h1]Regarding the Win 10 and Xbox One Controller Issue:[/h1]
We made some changes to the Xbox One controller settings and we hope it works with all Win 10 version. However, Xbox One controller works best in Win 10 with latest patch v.10.0.14393.

There is a known bug with the Xbox One controller and Windows 10 with Unity 3D engine.

Please try the below instructions and do let us know if it works fine.
[list]
[*]Open Device Manager
[*]Right Click "Xbox One Controller"
[*]Select Update Driver Software
[*]Browse on my PC
[*]Let me pick from a list
[*]"Microsoft Xbox One Controller"[/list]

[h1]What's Next![/h1]
We are now working on Keyboard Only Control Scheme for the game.

Please do share your feedback and suggestions at If you face any issues or at support@ogrehead.com or through our Discord server: https://discord.gg/7ZRQhrZ

As always we are here to help you! :)

Thank you.

[i]This patch is for Win and Linux users only.[/i]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/684382582f2e70d88786bae5c0255e7782e4b930.png[/img]

Hello,

We are glad to announce that the much requested WASD controls is now LIVE. We have also worked on tons of fixes and game balance. Check out the log below to know more about the same.

[h1]What's New! [/h1]
[list]
[*]Implemented WASD Control Scheme. Now you can use Keyboard to move and Mouse to look-at and shoot.
[*]Implemented extensive rebinding options for WASD.
[*]Now you can play the game only with the Mouse if you have one with additional buttons.
[*]Added an option to choose between WASD Control Scheme or Mouse Control scheme.

[*]Added a close button in the UI for Dukaan (Shop) and Lohaar (Blacksmith).
[*]Improved the text quality in the some of the User Interface in the game.
[*]Polished tons of User interface elements in the game.[/list]

[h1]Game Balance[/h1][list]
[*]Anyaay Shastra (Increase damage based on enemy in the room) duration is now time based instead of room based.
[*]Nirdaya Shastra (decrease enemy hp in the room) duration is now time based instead of room based.
[*]Bajrangi Claws will now have 50% instead of 100% chance to execute Vanara (Monkey) Enemies.
[*]Sacrifical Chest will now consume more Health based on the difficulty.
[*]Bosses drop 2 items and additional consumbales. MORE REWARDS! :)
[*]Optimized the difficulty via changing the algorithm for the room generation when playing in Asura difficulty.
[*] Reduced the damage of Nishana (Bow weapon which fires two arrows consecutively).
[*]Optimized the cost of Dukaan (Shop) items.
[/list]

[h1]Patch Log[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where in animation would play in inventory
[*]Fixed an issue where in Dukaan ( Shop) UI would overlap with Inventory UI
[*]Fixed an issue where in shop item would restock after save and load.
[*]Fixed an issue where in skill targeting radial would go out of room.
[*]Fixed an issue with Guardian room where in projectiles had a chance to kill you during the cut scene.
[*]Fixed an issue where in enemies would run out of room.
[*]Fixed an issue with enemy animation where in they would get stuck during certain attack animation.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Rakt(Life-steal) Shastra would not work with Melee weapons.
[*]Fixed an issue where in using 'Swastya Hathoda' Shastra ( the one where you throw hammer and if it kills, it heals you) would freeze the game when using agains the rats in Level 3.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Lord Bhadra's ( Naga Range Boss) heal reticle would follow you even after intrupting him using a spell.
[*]Fixed an issue where in 'Golmanda' (Boomerang) would not return after using against Elephant Shield Unit.
[*]Fixed an issue where in anathema wouldn't work when using spells to kill enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where in  Samartha' Naga Melee Champion would not die.
[/list]

[h1]IMPORTANT[/h1]
[b]Some players have notified us regarding the compatibility issue with Xbox one controller on Win 10. We have reduced the sensitivity of the D-pad in the hopes to resolve this issue. However, Xbox One controllers on Win 10 will work best with the latest update (V. 10.0.14393.0)[/b]



[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
We will now be working towards adding more content in the game. It is better if keep at as a suprise for now. We will be sharing some glimpses of what the content will be as we move forward!

As always, please do share your feedback and suggestions in the Discussion forum.

If you face any issues or bugs, you can contact us at support@ogrehead.com 
or via our Discord server: https://discord.gg/7ZRQhrZ

We are always here to help you!

Thank you!

Hi,

Asura Patch - 27497 is live!

[h1]Balance and New features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Weapon will not destroy any more, regardless of the difficulty. Only your armour will. Why? because we hear you!
[*]Changed the selection/highlight for enemies and color coded it. Purple for Magic enemies, Red for Melee enemies and Green for Range enemies.
[*]Increased the Parivartan cost to 15. No more can you break the game by earning unlimited gold using it in conjunction with Hadapan.
[*]Decreased the damage output of enemies in higher levels.

[b]Increased the Arrow capacity of the following Asuras:[/b]
[*]The Rakshas of Yodha: 40 arrow capacity
[*]The Rakshas of Chalak: 80 Arrow Capacity[/list]


[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the black screen issue which occurred after the last update, due to swapping left click and right click buttons.
[*]Fixed hitbox issues with traps. Now they will actually KILL you if you are not careful!
[*]Fixed an issue where in the Daeva Chakravyu/Deadly Rollers in level 5 would sink in the ground.
[*]Fixed an issue where in enemies would run off the room in Level 5.
[*]Fixed an issue where in projectiles would penetrate through walls.
[*]Fixed some of the issues with the wall colliders in the rooms.
[*]Fixed the Aukaad screen where in bosses death stat would not register properly even after killing all of them.
[*]Fixed localization issues with chinese.
[*]Fixed a shader issue which would cause the portals in level 5 to appear even during the death screen.
[*]Fixed an issue with camera angle which would cause the camera to not revert back to it's original position once bosses have been killed. (Camera rotation turned off)
[*]Tons of other minor bugs and UI fixes![/list]

[list]
[*]We are currently working on the WASD controls for the game.
[*]You will be able to switch between the Mouse controls and the WASD controls via the game's Setting option.
[*]We are working to make sure that you can enjoy Asura only with a mouse. This is for people with disabilities. [/list]

[list]
There is an issue reported where in when you cast a skill, Asura and the enemy will get stuck in the level.[/list]

You can send us the files at support@ogrehead.com or join our discord: https://discord.gg/7ZRQhrZ

Thank you!

[i]There are tons of issues in the WASD Beta branch. Please note that it is not the final version of the game. We recommend you only play it if you want to try the WASD version of the game.[/i]

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/09d5ef4975cf6b2fd3283720cde5ebbdc2829d40.png[/img]
[h1]This is a hot fix for Asura - 27293 [/h1]
[list]
[*]Reduced the Left analog stick sensitivity to 25%. 
[*]Fixed a save file related issue where in the UI wouldn't relfect the correct number of keys stored after saving the game.
[/list]

The left analog stick issue is being experienced by the some of the players in Asia. This is due to the hardware differences. Inorder to fix it, we had increased the sensitivity to 50% in our previous patch. This in-turn effected the players who were not facing the above issue.

Until we add the slider for the same, we hope 25% is a sweet spot with regards to sensitivity. If not, do let us know!

This was an emergency fix because we didn't want to hamper your experience until we addressed the other issues.

Thank you.

[i]This fix is for Windows version. we will be updating it for OS X and linux as well in a short while.[/i]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/3f1bb15905f21e6483ea982b1a7070f00e7f4be5.png[/img]

Hi,

This week has been super busy with us preparing for Asura showcase at Taipei Game Show 2017 however it has not hindered the progress in development and fixes of the game itself. In-fact, we have fixed a ton of issues and added some new minor features. One of the most exciting element we added is the Asura Voice over in the game. This is just the first pass but you can check it out via the demo. Also, made some significant changes to how the some of the weapons like magic, spear etc would work. The speed of their projectiles has been increased so that the combat feels much more fast paced. Also, we have worked tons of UI stuff which were pending for quite some time.

To check out changes and fixes in detail, have a look at the patch log below:
 [list]
[*]Polished the Result, Victorious, Death screens.
[*]Optimized the volume for BGM with default settings.
[*]Implemented restart in pause menu so that you can be utlra competitive! :D
[*]Added support for SpeedLink & Intex controller.
[*]Added tons of new options in the gameplay settings. Tweak it to your hearts content! 
[*]Removed restriction of interacting with items when near a corpse.
[*]Fixed an issue with Asura footsteps during the bleeding state.
[*]Added the current difficulty text in the pause screen.
[*]Gradient highlight will now fade in and out depending on the distance.
[*]Optimized the auto-aim priority between enemies and breakables.
[*]Attack delays has been optimized resulting in a faster paced combat when using heavy stamina based weapons.
[*]Increased the projectile speed of Boomerang, Magic and Spear Weapon. Swoooosh!
[*]Asura now speaks (this is just the first pass, more on this coming soon)! :D
Tweaked the scoring mechanic. TOP SECRET STUFF!
[*]Asura can now drop consumables from the stash via the HUD.
[/list]

Thank you for playing the demo and for all the support.

In case, you want to join the beta head over to > [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeoDXucv3J8ocYuRiJIHIkZUMDbN6G_XgCWrjXNFqhTAooW_g/viewform?c=0&w=1] Asura Beta Form	[/url]

Thanks,
Zain.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/744aa9300c848810da5d4165170502b635053476.png[/img]

Hello fellow demons!

For this week's update, one of the important things we were trying to figure out was how to improve our tutorial. Since you all had mentioned that the it was not fun, we spent some time play-testing about it then utlimately realised that it had to go. 

Now, we have replaced it with a new system which is much more straight forward. What we have implemented is something akin to how Dark souls approaches it's tutorial. Basically, there will be symbols which will inscribed on the corridor floors and walking over it will reveal pop-ups which will contain 'HINTS' on how to play the game. These pop-ups won't hinder player movement and you are able to freely pass through it. 

It seems to work for us but ultimately it's you folks who have to let us know whether it is good or not. One of the disadvantages of this new system is that since our level is randomly generated, sometimes, they dont appear in a pattern we intended. Neeraj has tried to use his arcane abilities so that everything works great but let's wait and see how it rolls!

Another exciting aspect we are looking forward to is the introduction of the leaderboard for the demo. We have even hosted a weekly torunament from this update onwards. We are calling it 'ULTIMATE DEMON KING' or 'UDK'. More rules can be found in our discord channel here > [url=https://discord.gg/7ZRQhrZ]Join Ogre Head Discord Channel[/url]

We have also went ahead and polished tons of stuff as well as fixed many issues. We are now working on the UI transitions which is still very much a work in progress.

You can know more about the update via the patch log below:
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where in Asura would get stuck after restarting the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where in the corridor would already be visible in the mini-map after restarting the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Asura would randomly sink under the ground and would become forever alone! -_-
[*]Polished the corpses of enemies because they mean a to lot to us. 
[*]Fixed an issue where it would lag on Asura's death. No more excuses when you loose!
[*]Removed the old tutorial which you all deemed as boring! Do you have any idea how long it took us to make that boring thing. ONE MONTH! :(
[*]Removed blacksmith in level 1 because we want to make the game unbeatable.
[*]Added Steam Leader-boards for the demo. Play, Compete, become the Ultimate Demon King!
[*]Changed the end screen flow for the demo.
[*]Added 'Hints' as a replacement to tutorial.
[*]Added in-game timer and score.
[*]Polished some of the UI transitions.
[/list]

To everyone playing the demo and sharing the feedback, thank you very much and for those looking to join the beta, sign up over here > 
[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeoDXucv3J8ocYuRiJIHIkZUMDbN6G_XgCWrjXNFqhTAooW_g/viewform?c=0&w=1/]Asura Beta Sign-up Form[/url]

Thank you for all the support!

Zain.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/9cfd3c946588b8adcd2aba9314ee31bf1deab70d.png[/img]

Hello,

First of all, Happy New Year to everyone!

Second, we have a new update for Asura mainly fixing tons of issues and bugs. We added some new elements for ex some new animals in the roster of doodads for different levels. Also, added some new breakables so that you can smash them to your hearts content. The game is almost feature complete and we are mostly focusing on fixing issues and making sure everything works fine. As of now, there are still tons of lingering issues which needs to tracked and fixed and for that we will definetly your help.

The folks who have been playing the Beta have been super helpful giving us feedback as well as notifying the issues. For that we are grateful and a big THANK YOU! :)

More about the updates in the below patch log:
[list]
[*]Fixed the notorious extra meat bug.
[*]Added new Rune unlock screen.
[*]Fixed an issue with Blink strike damage event showing up twice.
[*]Fixed an issue of unable to buy a key when stash is full.
[*]Fixed an issue with Crow shader for shadows.
[*]Add new breakables.
[*]Added new NPCs / Animals.
[*]Fixed some of the particle issues with enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where in Asura would get knocked out from the room by Spearmen.
[*]Added new elemental effects for all asura characters.
[*]Added new skeletons when absorbing / scavenging enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where in enemies would not avoid breakables.
[*]Added elemental based footsteps for Asura.
[/list]

Known Issues:
[list]
[*]One of the corridors is visible in Minimap from the previous run in tutorial.  [*]Asura animations sometimes get stuck in the 'Scavenge' part of tutorial.
[*]If asura dies after geting stunned, the character freezes in the next run.
[*]Rune Discovered UI
[/list]

Thank you!

Zain.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/a185be741d3d439b890e825952af6f9de3a40a4e.jpg[/img]
Hi,

Due to most of the work at this point revolving around the game a.k.a making trailers, marketing content and other additional resources, the update does not have any major content additions but yup, we have fixed a ton of issues. There is however this one very ugly issue which has crept up ever since we started sending out the demo. It is the one where upon picking up a meat, it will reflect as 2 meat in the inventory slot where in you won't be able to eat the other one. Well, as I was writing this, Neeraj reproduced it and now we understand the issue. If you press 'A' in controller or Keyboard while picking up the meat, this bug occurs. So for now please be careful as we will patch the issue in the next update.

Check out the complete patch log below -
[list]
[*]Updated Saving system. (Note: Previous save files will be lost!)
[*]Depth Of Field - UI effect option added in Visuals.
[*]Fixed some of SFX related issues.
[*]Added Achievements for Champions.
[*]UI effects added for Hearts.
[*]New Mage Item added.
[*]Fixed various UI related issues.
[*]Fixed issues with particle effects for Asura and enemies.
[*]Fixed an issue where sometimes bonfire would not burn during melee attack.
[*]Fixed an issue where a certain vanara enemy unit would not react to spells.
[*]Fixed an issue where picking up gold, quiver near death bodies was not allowed.
[*]Fixed an issue where Aukaad New did not disappear after opening and closing it.
[*]Fixed an issue where Varjun unlock appeared inspite of unlocking it earlier.
Fixed Bricks floating issue in floor 2.
[*]Dukaan and lohars gradient effect now fades in and out.
[*]Added new presets for Floor 2, 3 and 4.
[*]Fixed an issue where absorbing while leveling up would give the wrong amount of experience
[/list]

Thank you and Merry Christmas!

- Zain.

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/bd3e92b95d93b6bb5a3eaa9f6367e7cbea8d1142.jpg[/img]

Hello,

We have made some minor as well as drastic changes to the game last week.

For instance, there is no health bar any more but instead 'Heart Containers'. If you have been following Asura, you might have played a build long time which had hearts but then we changed it because the health of the player was going way more than what we could show in UI as hearts. But now it's back and we think it's going to stay this way. You might be wondering why the change after all this but we think Hearts represents health and progression better in a game like Asura. To truly understand the nature of the changes, you will have to check out the latest demo!

We have also polished some of the main menu and in-game UI elements in the game and we will be working on it more as we head close to release.

To know more about the changes and fixed, check out the patch log below!

[list]
[*]Added options in the game-play setting to turn on or off dynamic camera rotation.
[*]Fixed an issue where the look at position of Asura when rotating with a mouse would offset from the actual attack orientation.
[*]Descriptions added for the following menu buttons - Aukaad, Veda and Shastra.
[*]Changed the short-cut for quiver and meat from 'Q' and 'E' to buttons '1' & '2'.
[*]Fixed an issue where the stamina would refill at a higher rate. Yup, now it's difficult but only fair! :)
[*]Changed some of the HUD elements for Keyboard and Mouse configuration.
[*]Made and added a unique dodge animation for Asura when equipped with a hammer.
[*]Added new reaction animations for some of the enemies - Vanara and Hathira range units.
[*]Enabled blending in Asura dodge roll animation. Now it should be smooth as butter! :)
[*]Fixed an issue where in buttons would interact too early in the profile screen resulting in selecting the wrong profile.
[*]Removed the notification when switching hardware for controls. 
[*]D-pad will now work in Settings to toggle options.
[*]Polished the Leaderboard UI.
[*]Improved the UI for Aukaad, Veda, Shastra as well as character screens.
[*]Polished the symbols for controller buttons.
[*]Added new room presets for Level 1.
[*]Made some changes to one of Varjuna's attack.
[*]Fixed various other minor bugs and glitches.
[/list]

Thank you very much for playing the beta of Asura and for all the feedback.

If you would like to sign-up for beta, head over to > [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeoDXucv3J8ocYuRiJIHIkZUMDbN6G_XgCWrjXNFqhTAooW_g/viewform?c=0&w=1] Asura Beta Sign-up!	[/url]

- Zain

notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27001590/bd3e92b95d93b6bb5a3eaa9f6367e7cbea8d1142.jpg[/img]

Hello,

We have made some minor as well as drastic changes to the game last week.

For instance, there is no health bar any more but instead 'Heart Containers'. If you have been following Asura, you might have played a build long time which had hearts but then we changed it because the health of the player was going way more than what we could show in UI as hearts. But now it's back and we think it's going to stay this way. You might be wondering why the change after all this but we think Hearts represents health and progression better in a game like Asura. To truly understand the nature of the changes, you will have to check out the latest demo!

We have also polished some of the main menu and in-game UI elements in the game and we will be working on it more as we head close to release.

To know more about the changes and fixed, check out the patch log below!

[list]
[*]Added options in the game-play setting to turn on or off dynamic camera rotation.
[*]Fixed an issue where the look at position of Asura when rotating with a mouse would offset from the actual attack orientation.
[*]Descriptions added for the following menu buttons - Aukaad, Veda and Shastra.
[*]Changed the short-cut for quiver and meat from 'Q' and 'E' to buttons '1' & '2'.

[*]Changed some of the HUD elements for Keyboard and Mouse configuration.
[*]Made and added a unique dodge animation for Asura when equipped with a hammer.
[*]Added new reaction animations for some of the enemies - Vanara and Hathira range units.
[*]Enabled blending in Asura dodge roll animation. Now it should be smooth as butter! :)
[*]Fixed an issue where in buttons would interact too early in the profile screen resulting in selecting the wrong profile.
[*]Removed the notification when switching hardware for controls. 
[*]D-pad will now work in Settings to toggle options.
[*]Polished the Leaderboard UI.
[*]Improved the UI for Aukaad, Veda, Shastra as well as character screens.
[*]Polished the symbols for controller buttons.
[*]Added new room presets for Level 1.
[*]Made some changes to one of Varjuna's attack.
[*]Fixed various other minor bugs and glitches.
[/list]

Thank you very much for playing the beta of Asura and for all the feedback.

If you would like to sign-up for beta, head over to > [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeoDXucv3J8ocYuRiJIHIkZUMDbN6G_XgCWrjXNFqhTAooW_g/viewform?c=0&w=1] Asura Beta Sign-up!	[/url]

- Zain
